title: Average latency per service
intro: Users say the app feels slow. Calculate average request latency per service from the histogram's _sum and _count.

objectives.text: Show average request duration (seconds) per service

hints: Average = total time / number of requests, and both are counters.
rate(..._sum[5m]) / rate(..._count[5m]), aggregated by service on both sides.
debrief: _sum / _count gives the mean. Means hide outliers, which is why SREs prefer percentiles (histogram_quantile), coming later in the campaign.
